I read `AGENTS.md` and ran `node tools/read.mjs new-feature inventory types http`. `docs/flows/add-endpoint.md` uses this exact feature as its worked example. I didn't open the source files, so line numbers come from the docs and may have drifted.

## Worker

1. **`worker/src/types/index.ts`**
   - Add `RestBody { sessionId, characterId }` next to the other `*Body` types, which start around `ActionBody:146`.
   - Add a cost constant, for example `REST_COST`. The value is your call, since no existing constant covers it.
2. **`worker/src/routes/rest.ts`** (new file)
   - Export `restRoutes = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>()`.
   - The `POST` handler validates the body and calls `getCharacter`.
   - It rejects the request if `gold < REST_COST`.
   - It calls `updateCharacter(db, id, { hp: max_hp, gold: gold - cost })`. That function is at `services/character.ts:94` and only accepts whitelisted fields.
   - Optionally, call `askDM` for narration, then `appendHistory` and `saveSession`, and insert an `adventure_log` row. `routes/action.ts` is the template for this.
   - Keep the cost and HP math in the Worker. The AI only narrates.
3. **`worker/src/index.ts`**
   - Add `app.route('/api/rest', restRoutes)` in the route mounts at lines 41-48.
   - CORS (lines 19-35) needs no change unless there's a new origin.
4. **`worker/src/services/*.ts`**: only if logic is shared with other routes.
5. **`worker/migrations/000N_*.sql`**: not needed. `hp`, `max_hp` and `gold` already exist. If you do add one, never edit `0001`.

## Angular frontend

6. **`frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts`**
   - Add a `RestResponse` interface, for example `{ updatedCharacter: Character, … }`.
   - Mirror the Worker types by hand, because nothing enforces that the two match.
7. **`frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts`**
   - Add `rest(sessionId, characterId)` that posts to `${API_BASE}/api/rest`.
   - The existing methods end at `shopTransaction():109`.
8. **`frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts` and `.html`**
   - Add a Rest button. The Inventory button at `.html:9` is the model.
   - Add a handler that calls `GameApiService.rest`, then `CharacterStateService.setCharacter(res.updatedCharacter)` so the sheet updates.
   - The handler also pushes a system or narrative entry, and shows `err.error.error` on failure, such as not enough gold.
   - Keep the template in the `.html` file, not inline.
9. **`frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.spec.ts`**: add tests with `GameApiService` as a Jasmine spy.
10. **`frontend/src/app/services/character-state.service.ts`**: no change. It already has `setCharacter`.

## Docs to update in the same change

- Update the doc beside each changed file under `docs/code/…`. Add `docs/code/worker/src/routes/rest.md`, with links on both ends (AUTHORING §3).
- Add the new doc to `code.md`, then re-run `research-work/scripts/build-symbol-index.mjs`.
- Add the endpoint to `docs/PRD.md` §9.
- Update the `AGENTS.md` routing table only if a new feature area appears.
